matches.rationale: Finding 1 directly identifies Eq. (1)'s use of the reciprocal IC50 value rather than the logarithmic pIC50 transformation. It points to the same equation and the same omitted-logarithm defect.

pred_verdicts.rationale: It correctly detects the erroneous reciprocal-only pIC50 definition in Eq. (1).
It identifies a separate apparent abstract-versus-body metrics inconsistency not listed in the ground truth.
It raises a separate issue concerning the paper's R-squared definition in Eq. (4), not the Eq. (1) pIC50 error.
It identifies a separate likely invalid random-forest hyperparameter grid value.
It identifies a separate inconsistency between Gini importance and Gini impurity terminology.
The claimed negative test R-squared is inferred from training-set variance and does not follow from the reported test RMSE alone.
